answer_1.quote: This paper investigates leveraging LLMs for synthetic data generation to alleviate data scarcity in AM.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic argumentative texts with structured annotations (argument components and relations)

answer_2.quote: We use three micro F1 metrics adopted from previous work : F1 span for identifying argument component spans, F1 aci for further classifying their types, and F1 ari for detecting relations between them.
